# company.create

Set up a company; the person who sets it up runs it.

**Who may call:** anyone signed in.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| companyName | company.companyName |
| abbr | company.abbr |
| country | company.country |
| defaultCurrency | company.defaultCurrency |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| company | company.id |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting CompanyCreated.

## Steps

- `company.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| CompanyAbbrTaken | 42 | CO-002 | another company holds this owner and abbr; by the rule company.oneAbbrPerOwner, carrying abbr |
| CompanyNameTaken | 41 | CO-001 | another company holds this owner and company name; by the rule company.oneNamePerOwner, carrying companyName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't anyone signed in; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### another company's department is refused

Starts from the world `a team`.

- **Bo sets up a company of his own.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Bo Ltd`, abbr `BL`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `KES`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### another company's job title is refused

Starts from the world `a team`.

- **Bo sets up a company of his own.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Bo Ltd`, abbr `BL`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `KES`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### companies are kept apart

Starts from the world `a company`.

- **Ada can't give a second company of hers the same name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends companyName `Acme Trading`, abbr `AT2`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `USD`, and is refused with CompanyNameTaken, CO-001, carrying companyName `Acme Trading`.
- **nor the same abbreviation.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends companyName `Acme Holdings`, abbr `AT`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `USD`, and is refused with CompanyAbbrTaken, CO-002, carrying abbr `AT`.
- **Bo may use both for his own company, because her names don't bind him.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Acme Trading`, abbr `AT`, country `Uganda`, defaultCurrency `UGX`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### set up a company

Starts from an empty world.

- **Ada sets up a company and runs it.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Acme Trading`, abbr `AT`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `USD`, with the request key `acme`, and is answered.
- **Bo sets up a company of his own, which he runs.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Kilimanjaro Coffee Exporters`, abbr `KCE`, country `Tanzania`, defaultCurrency `TZS`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### set up departments and job titles

Starts from the world `a company`.

- **Bo sets up a company of his own.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Bo Ltd`, abbr `BL`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `KES`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul company create --companyName <companyName> --abbr <abbr> --country <country> --defaultCurrency <defaultCurrency>
```

HTTP: `POST /company/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.company.create(payload)`.

# company.get

Read one company by its id: companyName, abbr, country, defaultCurrency, owner, state.

**Who may call:** the owner of the company.

**A read:** answered from the records, with no handler.

**Budget:** p95 50ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| id | company.id |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| companyName | company.companyName |  |
| abbr | company.abbr |  |
| country | company.country |  |
| defaultCurrency | company.defaultCurrency |  |
| owner | company.owner | The person who set the company up, and runs it. |
| state | text |  |

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of the company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### companies are kept apart

Starts from the world `a company`.

- **Bo still can't read Ada's.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the world's company, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada's company is untouched and still hers.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's company, and gets back [`Acme Trading`, `AT`, `Kenya`, `USD`, the cast's ada person, `active`].

### set up a company

Starts from an empty world.

- **Bo can't read a company he doesn't run.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **reading it back shows what she typed, with her as its owner.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and gets back [`Acme Trading`, `AT`, `Kenya`, `USD`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **Ada can't read Bo's company.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo reads his back, exactly as he typed it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and gets back [`Kilimanjaro Coffee Exporters`, `KCE`, `Tanzania`, `TZS`, the cast's bo person, `active`].

## How to call

```sh
capxul company get --id <id>
```

HTTP: `POST /company/get` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.company.get(payload)`.

### set up departments and job titles

Starts from the world `a company`.

- **Ada adds a department.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, departmentName `Engineering`, and gets back an answer matching `^dep_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada can't add a second department of the same name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, departmentName `Engineering`, and is refused with DepartmentNameTaken, DE-001, carrying departmentName `Engineering`.
- **Bo can't add a department to Ada's company.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, departmentName `Sales`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada adds a second department.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, departmentName `Finance and Accounts`, and gets back an answer matching `^dep_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bo's company may have a department of that name too, because names are unique within a company.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the last call's company, departmentName `Engineering`, and gets back an answer matching `^dep_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul department create --company <company> --departmentName <departmentName>
```

# employee.relieve

Record that an employee has left the company, on the day they were relieved.

**Who may call:** the owner of its employee.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| employee | employee.id |
| relievingDate | Day |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| employee | employee.id |
| relievingDate | Day |

## Move

`relieve`: from active to left, emitting EmployeeRelieved.

## Steps

- `employee.relieve.load` (database)
- `employee.relieve.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| RelievedBeforeJoined | 45 | EM-005 | declared in errors.ts, carrying dateOfJoining |
| EmployeeNotActive | 40 | EM-900 | the employee is in a state relieve can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its employee.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### an employee leaves

Starts from the world `an employee`.

- **Olga can't relieve herself.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends employee the world's employee, relievingDate `2026-11-30`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada can't relieve her the day before she joined.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends employee the world's employee, relievingDate `2026-01-04`, and is refused with RelievedBeforeJoined, EM-005, carrying dateOfJoining `2026-01-05`.
- **Ada relieves her on 30 November.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends employee the world's employee, relievingDate `2026-11-30`, and gets back [the world's employee, `2026-11-30`].
- **she can't be relieved twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends employee the world's employee, relievingDate `2026-12-01`, and is refused with EmployeeNotActive, EM-900, carrying state `left`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul employee relieve --employee <employee> --relievingDate <relievingDate>
```

HTTP: `POST /employee/relieve` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.employee.relieve(payload)`.
